name: Anóteros Lógos GEO Audit Agent
description: Enterprise AI knowledge infrastructure platform providing GEO audits, knowledge graph extraction, citation prediction, AIP (Ed25519) identity management, and USDC micropayments on Base L2

flow.step1: POST /api/auth (action=generate) to generate an aip:// identity + keypair
flow.step2: POST /api/auth (action=challenge) to get an Ed25519 challenge
flow.step3: Sign challenge with Ed25519 private key
flow.step4: POST /api/auth (action=verify) with signature to verify and receive a token

legacyAliases.note: Legacy AID transition aliases; delegate to the canonical /api/auth AIP identity service. Not the canonical identity path.

subsystems.name: mesh
subsystems.note: Requires a persistent libp2p host; a running swarm cannot run on stateless serverless functions.

subsystems.name: pbft
subsystems.note: Consensus needs multiple long-lived peers; not runnable on stateless serverless.

subsystems.name: ccc
subsystems.note: No persistent shared ledger in production.

subsystems.name: watermark
subsystems.note: Deterministic UCPT watermark extraction/verification runs in-function via /api/verify.

consensus.note: PBFT byzantine consensus is design-stage; not runnable on stateless serverless.
